# The <label> tag

#### Course: Learn HTML

## The <label> tag

The <label> tag is used to define a label for form elements. For example,

```html
1<form>
2    <label>Enter your name:</label> <input type="text">
3</form>
```

Browser Output

![A webpage showing an HTML label tag.](data:image/png;base64,)

Both <label> and <input> tags are inline elements. Therefore, they appear on the same line by default.
